font.note: SVG text stays editable. Install Archivo for an exact match in another application. PNGs use the bundled font instances.

usage: References define concepts. Templates are visibly illustrative and contain no current readings or advice. Replace placeholder material with a cited, dated reading before using it as a decision artifact. Keep glyphs paired with their words.

assets.title: Four condition plane
assets.alt: Condition reference template. Funding pressure increases to the right and risk appetite increases upward. Sunny is cheap money with willing investors; Cloudy is pricey money with willing investors; Stormy is cheap money with wary investors; Freezing is pricey money with wary investors. No current reading is plotted.

assets.title: Condition definition key
assets.alt: Reference template listing all four canonical conditions beside their weather glyphs and definitions; it states no current condition.

assets.title: Pause and resume ladder
assets.alt: Illustrative threshold template on a 0–100 score scale. Example funding pressure is 72; pause above 70 and resume below 60. These values demonstrate layout and are not current guidance.

assets.title: Two thresholds with the same orientation
assets.alt: Illustrative paired threshold template on 0–100 scales. Funding pressure rises toward trouble: example 72, pause above 70, resume below 60. Risk appetite falls toward trouble: example 50, pause below 35, resume above 45. The lower scale is visibly reversed, so trouble sits on the right in both rows.

assets.title: Condition timeline template
assets.alt: Illustrative timeline template with six fictional equal-width weeks: Freezing, Cloudy, Cloudy, Stormy, Sunny and Sunny. Weather glyphs and words accompany every color. It is not an archive or a current forecast.

assets.title: Signal trend with threshold
assets.alt: Illustrative trend template on a labeled 0–100 score domain with six fictional readings: 22, 31, 28, 49, 61 and 75. A dashed pause line sits at 70. This is not a measured time series or current guidance.

assets.title: Signals to decision path
assets.alt: Process template: read dated signals, name the conditions using the weekly call, choose an action calibrated to company constraints, set pause and resume lines, and share the cited artifact. It contains no current recommendation.

assets.title: Pause and resume decision path
assets.alt: Blank bounded decision template with separate branches for the agreed pause condition and the resume condition. Pause uses the canonical pause glyph and line ink; resume uses the canonical play glyph and neutral ink. Placeholders contain no current guidance.

assets.title: Five area operating rules
assets.alt: Blank operating rule template covering the five canonical areas: Hiring, Roadmap, Fundraising, Spending and New bets. Each row has placeholders for action, pause line and resume line. No advice or current reading is prefilled.

assets.title: Decision change comparison
assets.alt: Blank decision delta template comparing a previous action and this week's action, with explicit placeholders for the reason and the reversal condition. It contains no current facts.

assets.title: Citable source note
assets.alt: Blank compact provenance template with placeholders for the reading, record date, retrieval time, source and readiness caveat. It asserts no actual source health or current values.

assets.title: Square share frame
assets.alt: Blank square share template with editable placeholders for the weekly call, decision delta, action, pause condition, resume condition and source note. It contains no current recommendation.

assets.title: Landscape share frame
assets.alt: Blank landscape share template with editable placeholders for the weekly call, decision delta, action, pause condition, resume condition and source note. It contains no current recommendation.

assets.title: Portrait share frame
assets.alt: Blank portrait share template with editable placeholders for the weekly call, decision delta, action, pause condition, resume condition and source note. It contains no current recommendation.

assets.title: Decision reveal end state
assets.alt: Static end state for the motion template, with placeholders for a bounded action and its reversal. The standalone HTML applies one short entrance, skipped entirely when reduced motion is requested.
